tours.title: Glacier Discovery - Sólheimajökull
tours.subtitle: Glacier Discovery - Sólheimajökull
tours.blurb: This is an informative, safe and guided glacier walk on the Sólheimajökull glacier tongue. Your certified glacier guide will lead you through a frozen wonderland of different shades of…

info.description:
This is an informative, safe and guided glacier walk on the Sólheimajökull glacier tongue. Your certified glacier guide will lead you through a frozen wonderland of different shades of glacier ice; white ice, blue ice, and crystal clear ice. You will get to see deep crevasses and meltwater pools in a safe manner, along with other interesting features of the glacier. Once on the ice, this is a straightforward walk suitable for most fitness levels, no glacier experience needed. Getting there and back is the part to prepare for: the access route covers roughly 7 km with about 350 m of elevation change, out and back along the same path, including a climb on the return leg. Expect around 3.5–4 hours of hiking in total, with 2–2.5 hours of that spent exploring the ice itself. During the hike, you will have plenty of photo opportunities and your expert guide will share his wisdom about the ever-changing landscapes of the Icelandic glaciers, their formation and interplay with the surrounding volcanoes and mountains. All necessary glacier equipment is provided, but clients must be fit enough for the activity and dressed for the weather conditions. This is a great way to experience the Icelandic glaciers up close and personal.

  • Safe and informative glacier walk
  • Sólheimajökull glacier views
  • Best for active, reasonably fit hikers

tours.title: ATV - Black Beach Safari and the Plane Wreck
tours.subtitle: ATV - Black Beach Safari and the Plane Wreck
tours.blurb: ATV/Quad biking is a great way to explore the raw black sandy beaches on the south coast. The adventure begins at our main base where we gear up and get to know the ATV’s/Quad’s.

info.description:
ATV/Quad biking is a great way to explore the raw black sandy beaches on the south coast.

The adventure begins at our main base where we gear up and get to know the ATV’s/Quad’s. After we have gone through the safety instructions we start the drive, trough small rivers and streams, to the sandy beach which derives from the dormant volcano Katla. After a fun ride on the black beach we stop at the famous DC-3 plane wreck to adore the amazing view up to Mýrdalsjökull glacier and along the big black coast all the way to Dyrhólaey, the southernmost part of Iceland. When we have synced in these beautiful sights we continue to the river Jökulsá and up to the foot of Mt. Heiðarhorn. Along the mountains we head back to the base.

Unforgettable experience of contrasting landscapes where the nature envelops the traveller in its warm embrace. On this tour you can get in touch with the raw black lava sand landscape by the south coast.

Please note:

All drivers must have a valid driving licence and a minimum age of 17 years. Note that a licence for driving a light motorcycle or a tractor is not sufficient.

Single ride on the ATV is mandatory for groups of odd numbers or solo travelers - paid on arrival at base

tours.title: Þórsmörk Super Jeep | Day Tour | Midgard
tours.subtitle: Þórsmörk Super Jeep | Day Tour | Midgard
tours.blurb: SUPER JEEP TOUR TO THORMSORK Þórsmörk (Thorsmork) Nature Reserve, or the “Valley of Thor” named after the Norse thunder god, is one of Iceland’s most captivating landscapes.

info.description:
SUPER JEEP TOUR TO THORMSORK

Þórsmörk (Thorsmork) Nature Reserve, or the “Valley of Thor” named after the Norse thunder god, is one of Iceland’s most captivating landscapes. Known for its expansive views, secluded waterfalls, dramatic canyons, birch forests, and glacier vistas. Þórsmörk is a beloved retreat for locals—a place to hike, connect with nature, and feel the powerful energy of land surrounded by three glaciers. This tour is perfect for travelers eager to step off the main paths and experience Þórsmörk from a local’s perspective.

Designed with a focus on “slow travel,” this tour takes time to appreciate each location beyond the camera lens. With experienced guides leading the way, visitors will cross unbridged glacier rivers in a super jeep and explore hidden spots throughout Þórsmörk, ensuring a safe and memorable adventure. Accessible year-round, the route adapts to the season’s unique character and is customized to match daily weather and road conditions, making every trip distinct. Guides will share their favorite locations and stories, providing insight into Iceland’s rich culture, myths, and untouched nature.

Highlights on Þórsmörk Super Jeep Day Tour may include:
  • Nauthúsagil Ravine: A unique canyon adventure.
  • Gígjökull Ice Cap: Site of the famed 2010 Eyjafjallajökull eruption.
  • Stakkholtsgjá Canyon: A mystical spot featured in Game of Thrones.
  • Valahnúkur Summit: Panoramic views across Þórsmörk Valley.
  • Glacier Views: Stunning scenes of Mýrdalsjökull, Tindfjallajökull, and Eyjafjallajökull.
  • River Crossings: Thrilling Super Jeep rides through Hvanná, Stakkholtsgjá, and Krossá.
  • Wildlife Spotting: Possible opportunity to see Arctic foxes in their natural environment.
  • Deep Nature Connection: Discover Iceland’s untouched highlands on paths less traveled.
  • Local Insights: Authentic stories and hidden spots shared by experienced guides.

Þórsmörk is remote and only accessible by rough mountain roads and unbridged glacial rivers. Our Super Jeeps make the journey safer and more comfortable, but guests should be able to step in and out of the vehicle with assistance if needed.

We keep our groups small, travel with local guides, and follow responsible driving practices in this fragile highland environment. Our goal is to help you experience Þórsmörk with care, respect, and a deeper connection to the landscape.

tours.title: Lava Show Vík
tours.subtitle: Lava Show Vík
tours.blurb: The only live LAVA SHOW in the world! Are you fascinated with lava, volcanoes, and geology? Would you like to see red-hot lava up close in a safe environment? Are you embarking on a journey…

info.description:
The only live LAVA SHOW in the world!

Are you fascinated with lava, volcanoes, and geology? Would you like to see red-hot lava up close in a safe environment? Are you embarking on a journey through Iceland, the land of fire and ice? If the answer is YES, you need to experienceLAVA SHOW Vík. It is the first and only live lava show in the world and has become one of the must-see experiences in Iceland! Just look at the incredible reviews!

An incredible and unique experience

In order to recreate a miniature volcano eruption, they superheat real lava from the 1918 Katla eruption and once molten, pour it into a showroom full of people. It is an incredible, unforgettable experience. In an instant, the showroom heats up to a toasty temperature. And as the audience sits safe in their seats yet only a few feet away from the flowing lava, it is mesmerizing to see, hear, smell and feel the incredible heat that radiates from it. It truly is a sensational experience!

The show begins with a short welcome by the host and then a short educational video about Icelandic volcanism, the volcanoes close by - with special emphasis on Katla volcano - and how the surrounding volcanoes have affected the locals throughout the ages. They even give you a personal story and tell you the evacuation plan in case Katla were to erupt right there and then!

Once the lava starts flowing into the showroom, the host literally starts PLAYING WITH THE LAVA! The host manipulates the lava with an iron rod, creating Pele's hair and tears, a miniature lava tunnel, a little lava cave and explains everything about what's happening as it goes. It is such an intimate, educational and entertaining experience and so different from everything else you've ever experienced, that you can't help feel in awe. And after the show, you truly see the rest of Iceland with different eyes and a newfound appreciation for nature. It really is a must see experience.
info.included:
A chance to get up close to real flowing lava!

The only live lava show in the world

Security goggles

A live host makes the show fun and personal

A short educational video about Icelandic volcanism

A true story from the 1918 Katla eruption

A sensory loaded experience - you feel the heat from the lava!

A Q&A session at the end of the show

A unique once-in-a-lifetime experience
info.requirements: Your good mood, eagerness to learn and willingness to ask questions. The show is always the most fun when people interact with the host. And if you booked your tickets online, it's enough to show the electronic tickets at the counter, no need to print them out.
info.attention:
We advice people to get there at least 10 minutes before the show, get their bearings and check out our gift shop before the show.

It gets HOT in the showroom when the lava pours in so people are advised to remove some layers of clothing before the show starts. The show is a safe experience and the heat should not be an issue but pregnant women, people with infants, and people with cardiovascular diseases are recommended to sit in the second row and/or close to the exit just to be on the safe side.

Everyone is advised to to keep their safety goggles on at all times during the show when there is lava in the showroom - also and especially when it is cooling down and solidifying.

tours.subtitle: LAVA Centre interactive volcano exhibiton and cinema - Full Experience
tours.blurb: LAVA Centre is the most awarded exhibition in Iceland, a beautiful and interactive expirence embraced by the five giant volcanoes surrounding the center.

info.description:
LAVA Centre is the most awarded exhibition in Iceland, a beautiful and interactive expirence embraced by the five giant volcanoes surrounding the center.

In the exhibition area visitors can learn about the geological wonders that form this volcanic island and the characteristics of different types of volcanoes. Interactive displays and earthquake simulators will provide an immersive experience for visitors.

The volcano cinema visitors can watch a 15 minute long film about the latest eruptions in Iceland and the impact of volcanic eruptions on the environment and local communities.

And finally the observation platform where visitors can see the five volcano up close and view the surrounding landscape from a bird's eye view including the neighbouring 4 glaciers. The platform provides an ideal opportunity to take photos and capture memories of the visit.

Finally guests can visit the gift shop and grab a coffee. The beutiful Rammagerðin gift shop is filled with beutiful souvenirs, local design and small gifts to take back home.

After visiting the Lava Centre, visitors will hopefully depart with a greater understanding of the wonders of volcanoes in Iceland and have a better understanding of the volcanic landscape en route.

The itinerary will take approximately 1 hour to complete, but many visitors use even more to enjoy all of the displays, watch the film and take in the stunning views from the observation platform.

tours.subtitle: Pearl Tour - Golden Circle Super Jeep Tour & Snowmobiling - from Reykjavik
tours.blurb: The Golden Circle tour allows visitors to get in touch with some of Iceland’s most famous and exciting natural phenomena.

info.description: The Golden Circle tour allows visitors to get in touch with some of Iceland’s most famous and exciting natural phenomena. Our first stop is at Þingvellir National Park, which is one of Iceland's most significant historical sites. It's the home of Iceland’s first parliament which was founded in 930 AD. From Þingvellir we head along mountain tracks toward the world-renowned geothermal area around Geysir Hot Spring, the one spouting hot spring on Earth after which all other spouting hot springs are named. From there we continue on to Gullfoss (“the Golden waterfall”) where your proximity to its edge is so close you can feel the spray of the glacial water on your face. Next, we kick the action into higher gear to get even closer to Iceland’s nature and go for a one-hour snowmobile tour on Langjökull, Europe’s second-largest glacier.

tours.title: Diving Silfra Tour - Selfdrive
tours.subtitle: Diving Silfra Tour - Selfdrive
tours.blurb: Dive between the North American and Eurasian continental plates in this once-in-a-lifetime experience.

info.description:
This thrilling tour takes you to the Silfra fissure, which is filled with fresh spring water, making it a popular site for diving tours. The crystal-clear water reveals an underwater world with jagged canyon walls, plant life, and fish. The fissure is said to have opened in 1789 due to moving tectonic plates. It never freezes, keeping a constant temperature of 35-37°F.

On the diving tour, you will receive a dry suit and be briefed on safety measures. Your expert guide will explain how to use the equipment and ensure you stay warm and comfortable during the 3-hour tour.

Once you’ve been briefed, a professional guide will lead you through the four parts of the fissure, including the Big Crack, Silfra’s most narrow section. Here, the continental plates are so close you can almost stretch out and touch them. The guide will also take you to Silfra Hall, which has striking colours and exceptional clarity, as well as the Silfra Cathedral and the Silfra Lagoon.

It’s surreal to feel the sensation of gliding in the water, kicking your fins and discovering this underworld. Even for the most experienced divers, the Silfra fissure is something special.

After the tour, as you relax and reflect on the experience, you will be served a delectable hot chocolate and cookies to warm you up.

If you’re looking for a tour that lets you get active and up close and personal with a significant part of Iceland’s unique geology, this tour is for you!

  • Hot chocolate and cookies

  • Be a certified diver at the level of PADI Open Water Diver or equivalent.

  • Have our Diving Medical form signed off by a doctor if they are age 60 or older

tours.title: Laki Craters Airplane Tour from Skaftafell
tours.subtitle: Laki Craters Airplane Tour from Skaftafell
tours.blurb: Take off from Skaftafell Terminal on this up to 50-minute airplane tour in Iceland to the Laki crater chain, one of Iceland’s most significant volcanic regions in the highlands.

info.description:
Take off from Skaftafell Terminal on this up to 50-minute airplane tour in Iceland to the Laki crater chain, one of Iceland’s most significant volcanic regions in the highlands. This flight combines glacier views with remote highland landscapes shaped by volcanic eruptions.

What to Expect

After departure, your pilot will guide the route based on weather and visibility, heading west toward the highlands and the Lakagígar crater row. Formed during the 1783 eruption, this 25 km-long fissure system stretches across the landscape and reveals its full scale from the air.

On the way, you’ll fly over parts of Vatnajökull’s southern outlet glaciers before reaching the moss-covered lava fields and crater formations of Laki. From above, the scale of the eruption becomes clear, with crater after crater extending across the vast highlands.

You may see:
  • Lakagígar (Laki crater chain)
  • Moss-covered lava fields from the 1783 eruption
  • Vatnajökull’s outlet glaciers
  • Highland mountains and volcanic terrain
Why Choose This Tour

This tour takes you into Iceland’s remote highlands, where volcanic landscapes dominate the terrain. Flying over the Laki crater chain is one of the few ways to fully appreciate its scale and formation, making it a strong choice for those interested in volcanic activity and Iceland’s geological history.

info.description:
Welcome to our most popular Ice Cave Tour!

Discover Iceland’s Blue Ice – Ice Cave Tour Update

Our Ice Cave Tour takes you to some of the mostbeautiful blue ice formations in Iceland, located on the west side ofBreiðamerk­urjökull, an outlet ofVatnajökull, Iceland’s largest glacier. Depending on weather and glacier conditions, guests may exploreone to three naturally formed blue ice features, offering an authentic and ever-changingIceland ice cave experience. These formations are reached by a guided glacier walk, led by trained and experienced glacier guides.

The full ice cave tour lastsaround 4 hours, occasionally3.5 hours, depending on conditions and group pace. Walking distances vary, and your guide will select the safest and most scenic route for the day. All required glacier equipment—microspikes or crampons—is provided, depending on the type of blue ice feature accessed during your departure.

Important:Iceland’s ice caves are natural, dynamic structures shaped by winter conditions. For safety and operational reasons,the cave location, glacier route, or overall tour setup may change at the last minutedue to weather, ice movement, or guide assessment. These adjustments ensure the safest and most rewardingblue ice cave tourpossible.

Because the glacier is constantly changing, conditions—and therefore the experience—may look very different from one week to the next. We monitor the changes daily to ensure you see the best blue ice formations of what Vatnajökull has to offer each day, with safety as our top priority.

This update reflectscurrent conditions, please note that this is thebest half day accessible blue ice experience available in Vatnajökull National Park

We will update our website as well as our social media with new informations if any changes.

Book now!

Don't miss your chance to explore the fleeting natural wonders of our receding glaciers - book early to secure your spot on our most popular winter tour!

Note:Ice Cave conditions may vary throughout the winter. Our expert guides ensure you'll always experience the best and safest locations available. Due to the popularity of Ice Caves you can expect to share the cave with other groups

tours.subtitle: Black Sand Beach Riding Tour
tours.blurb: Join us for a memorable ride on an unforgettable adventure along Iceland’s black sand beaches. This scenic tour is suitable for riders of all levels, including beginners.

info.description:
Join us for a memorable ride on an unforgettable adventure along Iceland’s black sand beaches.

This scenic tour is suitable for riders of all levels, including beginners.
For the safety and comfort of all participants, the ride takes place exclusivelyat walking pace. The deep volcanic sand and the wellbeing of our horses make this a calm and mindful riding experience. With a small group size of max. 5 guests, we ensure a personal atmosphere and attentive guidance throughout the tour.

Saddle up and follow the coastline along striking black dunes, feeling the fresh ocean breeze as you ride beside calm waves and head towards the open sea. With a bit of luck, you may spot seals swimming playfully in the water or resting lazily on the beach. The journey ends at a vast, untouched beach, with breathtaking views of the Atlantic Ocean, the Westman Islands on one side and Eyjafjallajökull on the other.

Our experienced and passionate guides will introduce you to the unique Icelandic horse – known for its friendly nature and smooth gaits. These sure-footed companions will carry you confidently across the ancient sands of the South Coast, revealing a side of Iceland few get to see.

This tour offers a peaceful yet powerful way to experience Iceland’s raw natural beauty — ideal for those looking for a slower, more immersive connection with the landscape and the horse.

Important info:

  • This tour takes place in South Iceland, approx. 1.5 hours from Reykjavík.
  • Minimum age: 10 years
  • Max. weight: 110 kg / 240 lbs
  • Riders must be able to mount and dismount independently.
  • Note: For safety, the tour pace is always adapted to the rider with the least experience. As such, it is very likely that the entire ride will be in walk.
  • Looking for a faster-paced ride? A private tour can be arranged upon request for more experienced riders. Please note, however, that we ride mostly through deep sand, so the pace must be adapted to the horses' needs.

What to bring: Warm layers (e.g., thermal underwear, wool/fleece sweater, scarf, gloves, windproof jacket), riding breeches or leggings, waterproof or water-resistant riding/hiking boots, sunglasses, and sunscreen.

Please be aware that the weather in Iceland can be very unpredictable, and in case of extreme conditions, we may need to adjust the tour route accordingly.

Feel free to contact us by phone at any time if you would like a different time slot or if the availability on the website doesn't meet your needs. We can't make any promises, but sometimes you get lucky and something is still available.

Vestmannaeyjar also boasts a rich history of pirate encounters, and you'll visit famous sites where these clashes occurred, hearing thrilling stories along the way.

Next, we'll follow the path of the pirates, visiting the site of the 1627 invasion and exploring locations where locals defended themselves. Finally, we'll end at Herjólfstown, delving into the lives of Icelandic pirates. This family-friendly tour combines stunning scenery with captivating tales of puffins and pirates.

We, of course, stop by at some beautiful sceneries along the way too. Among them is Gígjökull, an outlet glacier from Eyjafjallajökull, and from where a major glacial flood came down during the 2010 eruption, changing the landscape dramatically.

info.description:
Vistas and Volcanoes This day-long tour offers spectacular views featuring the variety of the magnificent Icelandic nature. In Reykjadalur Valley we will experience hot springs and also take a relaxing bath in a warm stream. On our way back to the farm, you can enjoy spectacular panoramas over the surroundings and also the waterfall Djúpagilsfoss. Later on we will have a fantastic view over the village Hveragerði and the Ölfus area, and also all the way down to the coastline, where we might see the Westman Islands, weather permitting. This is a unique opportunity to experience Icelandic nature in all its variety.

Please note: The tour is suitable for all levels of riding experience from beginners to advanced. During booking process, we ask our clients to inform us about their riding experience, which helps us to choose the right horse for everyone. Beginners and experienced riders ride together. We always try to tölt as much as possible, but do not gallop for safety reasons.
info.included:
Pick up and drop off, 5-6 hours riding – 19 km, lunch box, coffee and home baked cake after the tour.

We provide helmets and rain gear/winter overalls.
info.requirements:
Please wear clothes according to weather and solid shoes. We recommend hiking boots.

Bring your swim suit and towel.
info.attention: Summer tour! Departures: May 15 – September 15. Pick-up inReykjavikevery day at8:00(Please be waiting at the designated pick up location at 8:00). Return to Reykjavík ca. 17:15 Note that pick up from hotels inHafnarfjörður, Kópavogur and Mosfellsbæris at7:30and pick up from Hveragerði and Selfoss is at 8:45. Please double check your booking a day or two before arrival for the pick up location, as they may change without notice. Please note that there are no changing rooms in the valley. This tour is for everyone but participants should be in good physical condition. If the weather does not allow us to go into the mountains, the tour will be changed. Please let us know if there are any dietary needs like if there are allergies or vegetarians.
